source_description: Describe an image so a person who cannot see it knows what is there and what you are guessing.

source_title: Rewrite a notice in plain language
source_description: Rewrite a short official notice so a reader can say what they must do.

source_title: Check whether a sign can be read
source_description: Look at a sign and say whether the words can be read from the place a person would stand.

source_title: Write alt text you can check
source_description: Write alternative text that matches the image and leaves out a guess.

source_title: Offer a seated version of a task
source_description: Show how a standing task can be done from a chair, or say that it cannot.
Find a way into a place that does not use a step, using signs you can see.
Add words to a short clip so a viewer can read what is said.
Slow down and repeat a sentence when a listener asks, without adding new content.
Read a program note and say what the performance says it is, separate from your opinion.

source_title: Compare two objects in a gallery
source_description: Compare two objects using what you can see and what their labels say.
Find a shape, color, or phrase that repeats in a place or a work, and say where it returns.
Guide someone through three stops you know, with one true fact at each.
Describe a building from the street by its door, windows, and material.

source_title: Note one choice in a performance
source_description: Watch or listen to a live performance and name one choice the performers made.
Find the maker or the source of an object from a mark, a label, or a catalog.
Use a gallery map to find a room and a work, then the way back.

source_title: Prepare one question for a guide
source_description: Prepare a question a guide can answer from the place, and ask it.
Use a lever to lift a light load and say where the pivot is.
Compare two cups of warm water and say which stays warmer, without a medical claim.
Test small objects in water and sort them by whether they float.

source_title: Find the poles of a magnet
source_description: Find which ends of two magnets attract and which resist.
Mark a shadow twice and say how it moved.
Hang two objects so a stick hangs level.
Use a mirror to send a patch of light to a target you chose.
Separate a mixture of two safe materials with a sieve or a magnet.
Time a swinging weight and see what happens when you change the length.
Send a voice along a tight string and show that a slack string fails.
Compare two cloths by how they take up a spoon of water.
Charge a balloon or a comb and pick up a small piece of paper, then say when it stops.
Roll the same object down two ramps and say which was faster or farther.
Put two spoons in warm water and say which handle warms first.

source_title: Build a glossary for a topic
source_description: Collect words for one topic, each with a meaning in your own words.
Make an index so you can find a note by topic.

source_title: Trace a number to its source
source_description: Take a number from a text and find the source it cites, or say the source is missing.

source_title: Compare a headline with the text
source_description: Compare a headline with the first part of the article and say what the headline added or left out.

source_title: File a clipping with a date
source_description: Save a short clipping with its date and where it came from.
Log each source you open for one question, including the ones that did not help.

source_title: Turn a table into a sentence
source_description: Write one sentence a table supports, and one it does not.
Correct something you said or wrote, in the same place the mistake went.
Collect ideas from a group before anyone ranks them.
Group a list of ideas by similarity and name each group.
Let a group mark preferences with a limited number of dots, then read the result.
Set aside an off-topic point without losing it.
Do a task in a pair, then switch who leads and who checks.
After a task, say what worked, what failed, and one change.
Work until a time you set, then stop and say what is unfinished.
Ask whether anyone sees the decision differently, and record that view.
Walk to a marked spot on a cue and stop there.
Enter or speak when a cue happens, not before.

source_title: Be heard at the back of a room
source_description: Speak so a person at the back can repeat your sentence, without straining.
Hold an object so a watcher can see it, then pass or set it down on purpose.
Pause on purpose in a spoken line, and say what the pause did.
Do a short gentle voice warm-up and stop if anything hurts.
Move a simple puppet so a watcher can tell where it is looking.
Draw a flipbook in which one thing moves when the pages turn.
Move an object a little between photos so it appears to move.
Draw three panels in which something changes from the first to the third.
Cut a simple shape in a soft eraser and print it.
Form a small pot from a ball of clay that can sit without collapsing.
Join a handle or a coil to a clay body so it holds when leather-hard.
Weave paper strips into a mat that holds when you pick it up.
Fold an envelope that closes and holds a card.
Sew a patch over a small hole so the patch covers the damage.
Stitch across a small hole in knit fabric so it does not gape.
Fold one sheet into a small booklet with a cover and an order.
Walk a short way and note the sounds without recording anyone's private talk.

source_title: Name the sounds in a room
source_description: List the sounds in a room and mark one you cannot identify.
Describe a moment that is quiet, including the small sounds that remain.

source_title: Notice when people talk over each other
source_description: In a conversation you are part of, notice an overlap and make room.

source_title: Take notes for someone you accompany
source_description: Go with someone who asked you to, and write only what they want recorded.

source_title: Prepare a place for a guest to sleep
source_description: Prepare a sleeping place with a clear surface, a light, and a way to ask for what is missing.

source_title: Agree how you will check in
source_description: Agree with someone when you will contact them and what silence means.

source_title: Read steps while someone else works
source_description: Read instructions while another person does the task, and stop when they say stop.
Leave a silence so the other person can speak, instead of jumping in.

source_title: Pass an object so it can be taken
source_description: Pass an object handle-first, or say how the other person should take it.
Offer your arm as a guide, describe the next change, and stop when the person lets go.

source_title: Stay in the role you were given
source_description: At an appointment or a meeting, do only the task the person asked of you.
Read a public notice and say what it announces, who it is from, and the date.

source_title: Find who runs a local service
source_description: Find the office responsible for a local service, from a page or a sign you can show.

source_title: Read what a public question would change
source_description: Read a ballot or consultation question and say what it says would change, without choosing a side.
Find the time and place of a public meeting from an official notice.

source_title: Write a factual note to a local service
source_description: Write to a library, council, or similar service about a fact you saw, and ask one question.

source_title: Plan a visit from the opening hours
source_description: Use published opening hours to choose a time you can actually arrive.

source_title: Find an accessible entrance on a sign
source_description: Use a sign or a map at a building to find the entrance that avoids steps.
Save a confirmation so you can show the time and the reference later.

source_title: Steady a wobble you can see
source_description: Stop a small wobble with a pad or by moving the object, and say if the frame is the problem.

source_title: Tighten a screw you can see
source_description: Tighten one visible screw on furniture until it sits, and stop if it spins.

source_title: Silence a hinge as the label says
source_description: Quiet a hinge using only a product whose label says it can be used on a hinge.

source_title: Set a clock after it lost time
source_description: Set a clock to a time source you can name, including the date if it shows one.
Squeeze a brake and say whether the wheel stops, without adjusting a cable.
Thread a new lace so both shoes match and the ends do not pull out.
Put a curtain ring back on its rod so the curtain hangs with the others.

source_title: Fit a battery the right way
source_description: Match a battery to the marks in a device and seat the cover.
Add a legend so someone else can read the marks on your sketch.
Make a sign with one message that a person can read at a glance.

source_title: Test a form with a person
source_description: Watch one person fill a form you made or chose, and fix one confusion.
Put steps on a card in the order a person must do them.

source_title: Choose a size people can read
source_description: Set type or lettering large enough for the reader you have in mind.
Use colors to mean the same things across one page.
Lay out a page so a person can write a note on it.
Sketch a screen on paper and say what each part does before any software.

source_title: Note a track without guessing the animal
source_description: Record a track you see and leave it unnamed if you are not sure.

source_title: Watch an insect on a flower
source_description: Watch one insect visit a flower and write what it did.
Compare the edges of two leaves and say how they differ.

source_title: Notice a plant growing in a hard place
source_description: Notice a plant growing in a crack or a gutter and describe its spot.
Look at and feel the ground and say whether it is damp, and what you will not infer.
Split a long word into parts and say what each part does, using a dictionary when you need it.

source_title: Find the plain meaning of an idiom
source_description: Find what an idiom means in plain words, and the situation it came from if you know it.
In a sentence you did not write, point to the word order that carries the meaning.

source_title: Keep a phrase and its situation
source_description: Save a phrase you heard, the situation, and whether you would use it.
Read a sign in two languages and say what matches and what you cannot check.
Apologize for a specific act and offer a repair the other person can accept or refuse.
Hear a compliment and respond without cancelling it.
Ask to pause a conversation and say when you can return.

source_title: Name a boundary for a topic
source_description: Say that a topic is off limits for you, and what you can talk about instead.
End a conversation so the other person knows it is ending.
Congratulate someone for a specific effort, not a vague trait.

source_title: Share a mistake so others can avoid it
source_description: Tell others about a mistake you made, the cause, and the check that would catch it.

source_title: Place a lamp for the work
source_description: Place a lamp so the work is lit and the glare is not in your eyes.
Move a screen or a light so you can see the content.
Clear a surface so the task has room, and put the cleared things where you can find them.

source_title: Make a landing spot for essentials
source_description: Choose one spot for keys or a similar essential, and use it once.
Label a box with what is inside and check the label by opening it later.

source_title: Carry a load close to you
source_description: Carry a moderate load close to your body and put it down if the path is unclear.

source_title: Lift a box with your legs
source_description: Lift a light box by bending your knees, and stop if the box is too heavy.
Count events with a tally someone else can check.

source_title: Estimate a crowd from a sample
source_description: Estimate how many people are in a space by counting a part, and show the arithmetic.
Work out a sale price from the original and the discount, and compare it with the tag.

source_title: Divide a length into equal parts
source_description: Divide a length into equal parts and check by measuring.
Read a room or outdoor thermometer, including the unit, and say what you will not infer.
Convert a time between 12-hour and 24-hour forms and check it.

source_title: Tell which date order a document uses
source_description: Say whether a document writes the day or the month first, using a date that makes it obvious.

source_title: Ask for a story and write it down
source_description: Ask one prepared question about a memory, write the answer, and check it with the teller.
Put a few photographs in an order you can justify.

source_title: Write what you know about an old photo
source_description: Write what you know about an old photo, separate from what you suppose.

source_title: Find the chorus of a song
source_description: Listen to a song and point to the part that returns.

source_title: Clap the stresses of a word
source_description: Clap the stressed beats of a word or a short line.
Find the rhymes in a short poem and say where the pattern breaks.
Mirror a partner's slow gesture, and notice when you add a move they did not make.

source_title: Build a den that leaves the exit clear
source_description: Build a temporary den from chairs and cloth that does not block the way out.

source_title: Write a plant-care note for someone else
source_description: Write how to care for one plant while you are away, including when not to water.
Send a place pin and check that the other person opened the same place.

source_title: Use guide words in a dictionary
source_description: Use the guide words on a dictionary page to find a word.
Follow a see-also reference and say whether it answered your question.

source_title: Credit an image you may use
source_description: Use an image only if its terms allow, and write the credit those terms ask for.

source_title: Export a file someone can open
source_description: Save a file in a form another person can open, and check with them.
Summarize a written thread so a new reader knows the decision and the open question.

source_title: Unpack an archive and find the file
source_description: Open a compressed archive and find the file you were sent, without running a program you did not expect.

source_title: Check a link before you share it
source_description: Open a link yourself and say what the page is before you send it on.
Make a small stage from a box so a puppet can appear and leave.

source_title: Sort recycling by the sign in front of you
source_description: Sort items using the categories on the bin or the local sign, not a general rule.

source_title: Use a window as a light source
source_description: Place work near a window and say when the daylight is not enough.

source_title: Agree a spot for a shared tool
source_description: Agree where a shared tool lives, and put it back once.

source_title: Draw the route of a story
source_description: Draw where a story you heard or read moved, and mark a place you do not know.
Point to the strong beat in a piece of music you can hear.

source_title: Name an instrument you can hear
source_description: Name one instrument in a recording, and say if a second sound is unknown.

source_title: Plan a quiet hour for a shared space
source_description: Agree one quiet hour in a shared space and keep it.
Return something you borrowed in the condition you agreed, and say if it changed.

source_title: Set a rule for a shared playlist
source_description: Agree how a shared playlist works, then add one track that follows the rule.

source_title: Mark a walk for someone else
source_description: Mark a short walk you know so another person can follow your notes.
Notice a word a speaker or a page repeats, and say what job it might be doing.

source_title: Build a tiny paper model of a room
source_description: Fold a tiny model of a room you are in, with the door in the right wall.

source_title: Test a chair before you use it as a step
source_description: Decide not to stand on a chair that rocks, and choose a safer way to reach.

source_title: Read the care line on a tool
source_description: Read the one-line care note on a tool and do only that, or say you will not.
If you see an exit blocked, tell the person responsible and leave the fixing to them.

source_title: Choose a seat you can leave
source_description: Choose a seat you can leave without climbing over people, when you have a choice.

source_title: Ask where to start in a gallery
source_description: Ask a guard or a desk where to start, and follow or adapt their answer.

source_title: Notice a label you cannot read
source_description: When a label is in a language you do not read, say so and find another way to the fact you need.

source_title: Make a rubbing of a texture
source_description: Make a rubbing of a texture you are allowed to touch.
Stack books or boxes so the pile is smaller at the top and does not lean.

source_title: Match a lid to its container
source_description: Match lids to containers and set aside one that does not fit.

source_title: Coil a cable without a kink
source_description: Coil a cable so it lies in loops and uncoils without a knot.
Match pairs from a wash and set aside the items that have no partner.

source_title: Lay out tools for a task
source_description: Lay out only the tools a task needs, in the order you will use them.
Read a size chart and say which size matches a measurement you have.
Follow a folding diagram one picture at a time and undo a wrong fold.

source_title: Trace a shape and cut it out
source_description: Trace a shape and cut it out so the line is still visible or just gone, as you intended.
Fold a card that stands up and carries one message.

source_title: Set a blanket out of the path
source_description: Set a blanket where people can still pass, and pack it up.
Count a small collection and write the number so you can check it later.
Describe a dance you watched by naming one movement and one change, without claiming you can dance it.

source_title: Clap along and stop when you lose it
source_description: Clap along with music and stop when you are no longer with it, then say where you lost it.

source_title: Choose a book by its blurb and check the opening
source_description: Choose a book from the blurb, then check the opening and say if the blurb matched.

source_title: Mark a page you will return to
source_description: Mark a page with a note that tells your later self why to return.
Say why a joke you heard worked, without repeating a joke that targets a person in the room.
In a set of instructions, find a step that is said twice and might conflict.

source_title: Make a checklist someone else can tick
source_description: Write a checklist another person can tick without asking what the boxes mean.
Agree one hand signal and use it once at a distance where speech is hard.

source_title: Introduce a speaker in one sentence
source_description: Introduce a speaker with their name and why they are speaking, in one sentence.
End a practice on the agreed time and say what the next practice will start with.
Label a costume piece with the role and where it returns.

source_title: Call a cue for someone else
source_description: Give a cue at the agreed moment and not early.

source_title: Darken a room for a viewing
source_description: Darken a room enough to see a screen or a projection, and restore the light after.

source_title: Seat people so they can see
source_description: Arrange a few seats so each person can see the front, and move one that cannot.
Write a short note that tells a reader what difficult thing is ahead, without describing it at length.

source_title: Offer a written version of what you said
source_description: After you explain something aloud, offer the same points in writing.

source_title: Check a doorway with a tape
source_description: Measure a doorway and compare it with a width you were asked about.
Bundle cables you may touch and label what each one serves.

source_title: Look up a washing symbol you do not know
source_description: Look up one care symbol you do not know, from a chart you can show.

source_title: Make a timeline from stories you were told
source_description: Put stories you were told on a timeline and mark what has no date.

source_title: Learn the order of a public ceremony
source_description: Learn the order of a public ceremony you may attend, and what a visitor is asked to do.

source_title: Choose a table you can work at
source_description: Choose a table for a quiet task and move if it does not work.

source_title: Borrow a library item and note the due date
source_description: Borrow an item and record when it is due, then return or renew it.

source_title: Report something broken in a public place
source_description: Report a broken bench, a light, or a similar public thing to the office that handles it.

source_title: Change a plan from a weather icon
source_description: Read a forecast icon for the hour you care about and change one plan.

source_title: Keep a list of questions for a visit
source_description: Write questions before a visit and mark which ones got answers.

source_title: Draw a diagram of a process you did
source_description: Draw a process as boxes and arrows, including one decision.

source_title: Separate a fact from a recommendation
source_description: In a short text, mark a fact and a recommendation.

source_title: Make a symbol key for your notes
source_description: Choose a few symbols for your notes and use them the same way twice.
Ask a group for one quiet minute and say what it was for.
Show a hand position for a craft or a piece of music and correct one visible difference.

source_title: Pack a shared bag from an agreed list
source_description: Pack a bag from a list two people agreed, and show the item you left out.

source_title: Write the step-free note on an invitation
source_description: Add a step-free arrival note to an invitation, or say you do not know it yet.

source_title: Practice saying a name you find difficult
source_description: Ask how to say a name, practice it, and use it once.
Say no to a photo, or ask where it will go before you agree.

source_title: Label a drawer of small parts
source_description: Sort a drawer of small parts into labeled groups.
Read how a queue works and take the right next step.

source_title: Note the exit when you arrive
source_description: When you arrive in a public room, look for the exit sign and the path, without a drill.

source_title: Choose a meeting spot if you get separated
source_description: Agree a meeting spot before you enter a crowded place.
Label a shared box with the room and one fragile fact.
Read a place's photo rule and leave one thing unphotographed.

source_title: Ask before you touch a display
source_description: Ask whether a display may be touched, and keep your hands off until the answer is yes.

source_title: Record the name of a piece you liked
source_description: Write the name of a work you liked and one reason, so you can find it again.

source_title: Hum a note and hold it
source_description: Choose a comfortable note, hum it, and stop when it wavers.

source_title: Tap a rhythm and repeat it
source_description: Tap a short rhythm, then repeat it the same way.

source_title: Fold a letter and put it in an envelope
source_description: Fold a letter so it fits an envelope and the greeting is what you see first when it opens.
Make a table of contents that matches the pages in a packet you assembled.
Agree what calendar colors mean and use them on one week.

source_title: Write an agenda item in one line
source_description: Write one agenda item so the group knows the outcome you want.
Collect questions before a talk so the speaker sees them in time.

source_title: Thank a host for a specific thing
source_description: Thank a host for something they actually did during the visit.

source_title: Offer water before a long task
source_description: Offer water before a long task and accept no.
Tell or show a guest where the toilet is, including any step.
Agree who clears up after a shared task, before the task ends.

source_title: Tell a guest what they may use
source_description: Tell a guest what they may use in the kitchen or the room, and what to leave.

source_title: Measure a window for a covering
source_description: Measure a window's width and drop and write the numbers with the unit.

source_description: Detector tests stay with the device card and with pack-09. No procedure is included. Kept for specialist review.
